title: Athos 2643
overview: In the distant future, in a monastery on the lonely Neptune moon of Athos, a mysterious crime unfolds. An artificial intelligence responsible for life support comes under suspicion of murder. An inquisitor specializing in artificial intelligence is sent to solve this mysterious case.

title: The Fortnite Movie
overview: When the Zero Point begins to destabilize, conflicted Imagined Order agent Jones defects and joins The Seven in an all-out war to free the Island from the Loop. As epic battles erupt across the Island, a mysterious shapeless being named Geno watches and scans their every move, revealing that the true enemy is far greater than anyone imagined.

title: Blasphemous
overview: Two clerics – a rookie priest and his devout mentor must transport a possessed young woman to a secure location for an exorcism. All hell breaks loose when she unexpectedly escapes, putting their lives on the line and their faith to the ultimate test.

title: Wochenendrebellen 2
overview: When Mirco and Fatime realize that their 15-year-old autistic son, Jason, is experiencing puberty from a perspective all his own, Mirco sees an opportunity in a new promise: Together, father and son embark on an extraordinary journey through Germany’s soccer clubs to raise funds for the construction of a well in Kenya and, in the process, test Jason’s independence.

title: The Great Beyond
overview: An author of popular fantasy novels discovers that the mythical world he’s known for creating is actually real.

title: Mama, bitte lern Deutsch
overview: Tahsim is eight, loves buttered corn, and hates letters—especially those from the immigration office. Because his mother, Xatun, can neither speak nor read German, he becomes her interpreter, navigating waiting rooms, bureaucratic jargon, and the threat of deportation. At home, Xatun is a linguistic genius full of wit and stories, but outside she’s at a loss and resorts to simple words with flawed sentence structure. While Tahsim struggles to fit in at school with made-up religions and perfect German, he finds himself feeling ashamed of his mother more and more often. Until he realizes that she isn’t the problem—but rather the question he’s been asking her his whole life.

title: School of Magical Animals 5
overview: The students are having a school dance in Winterstein. Finja is glad that Sydney the koala is looking after her younger siblings. Outsider Zack revealed the secret of the magical animals to a stranger online - and now he’s been given Zeki the porcupine. Will the class manage to catch the animal thief together?
